scope: completed local experiments with explicit V5 terminal decisions, V5 sidecars, or V5 profiling acceptance

excluded_nonterminal.reason: local authority records only RUNNING and contain no terminal decision

excluded_legacy.reason: V4-only records remain under their original contracts and are not relabeled as V5 trajectories without a V5 sidecar

conversion_rules: historical decisions and acceptance artifacts remain immutable authority
retrospective_partial records preserve unknown facts as unknown
infrastructure attempts are actions rather than scientific outcomes
known measured native costs are recorded without cross-hardware conversion
protected-role access is never inferred from absence of data
